limitations: Null means photographer identity is unconfirmed, not that the image has no creator.
CC0 rights metadata does not identify a photographer; this batch did not revalidate individual photo licenses, delivery or botanical identity.
Twenty retained creator names are historical metadata, not freshly authenticated identities.
Eleven covers, Lokoloko regionFound and two secondary identity holds remain unresolved.
49 descriptive core-field drafts do not establish safe medicinal recipes or complete beginner guides.
Human content/category/botanical review, source-reuse review, backup and all-state private transactional duplicate checks remain required.
No real isolated PostgreSQL import, rollback or concurrency validation was performed.
No public herb was added or edited; the fifty drafts are not public AI knowledge.
